about: restricted coin: wallet to wallet transfers revert unless a side is on the allowlist; coin moves to or from the PoolManager only within the transient allowance the canonical hook grants for a canonical swap, so it trades through the universal router and permit2 with neither allowlisted. The factory seeds the allowlist with this launch's locker, the launch extensions and the entries of restriction.allowed; it seeds no router or forwarder. List an entry in restriction.allowed only for a contract whose coin outflows are fixed by its own logic (an airdrop or vault paying configured recipients); a router, aggregator, multicall or smart wallet listed there reopens wallet to wallet transfers for everyone. The coin admin can add entries, turn restriction off once, and lock both. Replace every treasury placeholder (0x7ea5...0001) and set example to false before a broadcast. The optional extensions array (dev buy, airdrop) is omitted here; see example-devbuy.json.

fee.referralBpsNote: 0 turns referrals off. The coin admin can set it later, up to 100.

mev.note: startingSkimBps and windowSeconds are required when a mev module is set
